title: This Leaf Blower Deal Is a Real Treat. The Toilet Paper Cannon Is the Trick
gist: A promotional deal post: the Ego Power+ 880 CFM leaf blower, WIRED's top-tested model, is $379 at Lowe's (from $439) with a backup battery until November 4, paired with a how-to for a toilet paper cannon.

insights.claim: The Ego Power+ 880 CFM battery leaf blower is discounted to $379 from $439 (14% off) at Lowe's with a backup battery, ending November 4.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Seasonal promotion of a premium battery tool; limited investment signal.

insights.claim: WIRED rates the Ego 880 CFM the best battery blower tested, the quietest, and the only one to knock over a 5-pound paver without turbo mode.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Reviewer favor can support brand demand in battery outdoor power equipment.
insights.locator: one model blew away the competition
